subject: Fix make_calendar bfill future-leakage
description:
_shared_modules/engineer_features.py:232-235. weighted_dist uses .replace(0,nan).ffill().bfill().fillna(0). The bfill pulls FUTURE distribution values backward across gap months -- real leakage.

Fix: drop .bfill(), keep .ffill().fillna(0). Leading gaps fill 0, not a future value.

Also fix the docstring at :196-203: it documents only the CROSS-GROUP leak (handled via group_keys) and is silent on within-series future leakage -- which is why this survived review.

Shared module: affects all 4 categories.

Verify: unit-test a series with a leading gap -- gap fills 0, not the later value.
